DC-2025-B260810.aiSummary: This bill would symbolically rename C Street, NE, between 4th Street, NE, and 6th Street, NE, as "Veola Jackson Way." It affects that stretch of street in the District of Columbia and would take effect only after mayoral approval, a possible veto override, a 30-day congressional review, and publication in the District register.

DC-2025-B260799.title: HealthCare Facilities Regulation Amendment Act of 2026

actions.text: Committee Mark-up of B26-0799 by the Health Committee

Notice of Public Hearing Published in the District of Columbia Register
Referred to Committee on Health
Notice of Public Hearing filed in the Office of Secretary by Health
B26-0799 Introduced by Chairman Mendelson at Office of the Secretary

documents.label: Notice of Public Hearing filed in the Office of Secretary by Health

DC-2025-B260799.aiSummary: The measure would update District rules for health care facilities and providers, including assisted living residences, home care agencies, and other licensed health care entities. It would require reporting of adverse events and cybersecurity events, add patient safety group participation, and let the health department use stronger fines and inspections in some cases. It would also add some new licensing rules, clarify ownership disclosure, and allow some fee changes tied to inflation.

DC-2025-B260524.title: Distribution of False Sexual Imagery Prohibition Amendment Act of 2025

actions.text: Public Hearing on B26-0524
Notice of Public Hearing Published in the District of Columbia Register
Notice of Public Hearing filed in the Office of Secretary by Judiciary and Public Safety
Notice of Intent to Act on B26-0524 Published in the District of Columbia Register
Referred to Committee on Judiciary and Public Safety
B26-0524 Introduced by Councilmember Henderson at Office of the Secretary

documents.label: Notice of Public Hearing filed in the Office of Secretary by Judiciary and Publ…

DC-2025-B260524.aiSummary: The bill would add new criminal penalties for sharing false sexual images, videos, or audio made or changed with digital tools, including AI. It would apply to people in the District who knowingly share these images without consent, and it sets a felony for more serious cases and a misdemeanor for other cases. It also gives an exception for certain licensed communications companies and says the act would take effect after mayoral approval and a 60-day congressional review.

DC-2025-B260854.title: Saint Elizabeths Hospital Independence and Governance Amendment Act of 2026

actions.text: Public Hearing on B26-0854
Notice of Intent to Act on B26-0854 Published in the District of Columbia Register
Notice of Public Hearing Published in the District of Columbia Register
Referred to Committee on Health
Notice of Public Hearing filed in the Office of Secretary by Health
B26-0854 Introduced by Councilmember Henderson at Office of the Secretary

documents.label: Notice of Public Hearing filed in the Office of Secretary by Health

DC-2025-B260854.aiSummary: The bill would make Saint Elizabeths Hospital an independent District agency run by a 13-member board. It would also create a patient safety and rights committee, add more patient rights and reporting rules, and set up a separate hospital fund. The change would move hospital control from the Department of Behavioral Health, with the transfer planned for October 1, 2028, or later if the Council sets a later date.

DC-2025-B260733.aiSummary: Enacted in the District of Columbia, this temporary act changes the deadline for the Prearrest Diversion Task Force to give its first recommendations on prearrest diversion for certain misdemeanor offenses and groups of people. It sets one deadline at no later than June 2025 and another at no later than July 31, 2026. The act takes effect after mayoral approval and congressional review, and it expires after 225 days.
